pois.name: Arktisk-alpin botanisk hage
pois.intro: The Arctic–Alpine Botanic Garden is the world's northernmost botanic garden. It is located in Tromsø, Norway, and is run by the Tromsø University Museum.

pois.name: M/S Polstjerna
pois.intro: MS Polstjerna is Norway's best-preserved sealing ship. The Polstjerna is owned by the Tromsø University Museum, and since 2004 it been exhibited in a dry dock in a conservation building near Polaria in Tromsø.

pois.name: Tromsø museum
pois.intro: Tromsø University Museum is a university museum located in Tromsø, Norway. Founded in 1872, it is one of the oldest scientific institutions in Northern Norway and has been part of the University of Tromsø since 1977.

pois.name: Tirpitz
pois.intro: Tirpitz was the second of two Bismarck-class battleships built for Nazi Germany's Kriegsmarine prior to and during the Second World War. Named after Grand Admiral Alfred von Tirpitz, the architect of the Kaiserliche Marine, the ship was laid down at the Kriegsmarinewerft in Wilhelmshaven in November 1936 and her hull was launched two and a half years later.

pois.name: Tromsdalen kirke
pois.intro: Tromsdalen Church or the Arctic Cathedral is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Tromsø Municipality in Troms county, Norway. It is located in the Tromsdalen valley on the east side of Tromsø.

pois.name: Tromsdalstinden - Sálašoaivi
pois.intro: Tromsdalstinden or Sálašoaivi or Sálaščohkka is a mountain in Tromsø Municipality in Troms county, Norway. The 1,238-metre tall mountain is located at the southern end of the Tromsdalen valley, just southeast of Tromsø.

pois.name: Tromsø domkirke
pois.intro: Tromsø Cathedral is a cathedral of the Church of Norway located in the city of Tromsø in Tromsø Municipality in Troms county, Norway. The cathedral is the church for the Tromsø Domkirkens parish.

pois.name: Vår Frue kirke
pois.intro: The Cathedral of Our Lady, also commonly known as the Church of Our Lady, is the Catholic cathedral of the city of Tromsø, Norway, and seat of the prelature of the same name. It is the northernmost Catholic cathedral in the world.

pois.name: Polaria
pois.intro: Polaria is an aquarium situated in Tromsø in Troms, Norway. It is the world's most northerly aquarium.

pois.name: Elverhøy kirke
pois.intro: Elverhøy Church is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Tromsø Municipality in Troms county, Norway. It is located in the city of Tromsø.

pois.description: Cable car to Mount Storsteinen (421m). The ride takes 4 minutes. (Source: website)

pois.name: Perspektivet Folkeparken
pois.intro: Friluftsmuseet i Folkeparken är ett norskt friluftsmuseum i Tromsø i Troms fylke. Det ingår sedan 1996 i Perspektivet Museum och hette dessförinnan Troms Folkemuseum.
